module_role: Hardware host-device interface between a NAND Flash controller (master) and one or more NAND Targets (slaves) within a NAND package, defining wires + cycle types + command set + status / parameter / unique-ID readback + features. A concrete NAND Flash Controller IP (host side) implements ONFI behind a system bus (AHB/AXI/PCIe NVMe) and a NAND Target (device side) implements the array + page register + interface PHY.

integration_overview.wire_count_sdr_x8_basic: 12-14 (CE_n, CLE, ALE, WE_n, RE_n, WP_n, R/B_n, DQ[7:0], Vcc/VccQ/Vss/VssQ pair)
integration_overview.wire_count_nv_ddr_x8_basic: 13-15 (adds DQS; WE_n and CLK share pin; RE_n and W/R_n share pin)
integration_overview.wire_directions: CE_n/CLE/ALE/WE_n/WP_n: host→device. RE_n/CLK: host→device (NV-DDR family). R/B_n: device→host (open-drain). DQ[7:0]: bidirectional. DQS / DQS_t/DQS_c: bidirectional (NV-DDR family). Vcc/VccQ/Vss/VssQ: power.
integration_overview.chip_select_per_target: Each NAND Target (LUNs sharing one CE_n) is selected by its CE_n pin; CE_n pin reduction allows multiple targets to share one CE_n with per-target Volume Address.
integration_overview.controller_role: Host always generates the cycle-type strobes (CLE/ALE/WE_n or CLK) and initiates every transaction.
integration_overview.open_drain_rbn: R/B_n is open-drain — multiple targets wire-OR; external pull-up required.

interface_categories: Power (Vcc core, VccQ I/O, Vss, VssQ; optional Vpp for high-voltage Program/Erase efficiency; VDDi for EZ NAND internal regulator stabilization)
Control (CE_n, CLE, ALE, WE_n / CLK, RE_n / RE_t/RE_c / W/R_n, WP_n)
Reference (VREFQ for NV-DDR2/3 single-ended; ZQ tied to Vss through RZQ; ENi/ENo for CE_n reduction enumeration; VSP vendor-specific)
interconnect_topologies_supported: Single-controller + single-target (most common, single NAND package per channel).
Single-controller + multiple-target on one channel (channel mux): multiple CE_n / shared CLE/ALE/WE_n/RE_n/DQ; targets active one-at-a-time per CE_n LOW.
Single-controller + multiple-target with CE_n pin reduction (Volume Select): one shared CE_n; per-target Volume Address.
Independent Data Buses (Section 2.16): two separate 8-bit DQ buses (DQ_0, DQ_1) on a single package for double the per-package throughput.
Multi-channel SSD controller: parallel channels, each running ONFI independently.
default_signal_values_when_omitted: External pull-up (typ. 10 kΩ) on R/B_n; external pull-up or pull-down on WP_n per board policy. ENi pulled to a defined level during CE_n-reduction enumeration; VSP pins have internal pull-up or pull-down per vendor spec. ZQ tied to Vss through RZQ (300 Ω ±1 %).
soc_dependent_items: ONFI-compliant NAND Flash Controller (NFC) IP with channel scheduler, ECC engine (BCH or LDPC, ≥ 4 bits per 512 B sector for ONFI 4.x), wear-leveling, garbage collection, FTL (Flash Translation Layer).
Per-channel PHY: SDR (LVCMOS / SSTL-class drivers) or NV-DDR / NV-DDR2 / NV-DDR3 (source-synchronous DDR drivers + DLL / DCC for high-speed modes).
Per-channel VccQ regulator (3.3 V → 1.8 V → 1.2 V switching for high-speed modes).
Optional external Vpp regulator for improved Program/Erase efficiency.
External RZQ resistor (typ. 300 Ω ±1 %) on each ZQ pin to Vss.
External R/B_n pull-up on each channel.
DMA controller for page-register fill / drain.
Interrupt routing (per-LUN ready, ECC error, ECC threshold).

pull_up_resistors.purpose: Default protection or release; per-board policy.
Defines safe default when host does not drive.

low_power_modes.Standby: CE_n HIGH while target is ready (RDY=1) → target enters low-power standby; ICC1 typical.
low_power_modes.Deep_power_down: Vendor-defined via Set Features or Vcc/VccQ removal.
low_power_modes.ClockStop_NV_DDR: Host may stop CLK during NV-DDR Idle; DQS held HIGH if ODT enabled.
low_power_modes.Vpp_disabled: Set Features (39h) disables external Vpp when Program/Erase efficiency not required.
low_power_modes.Sleep: Not explicitly named in ONFI; achieved by gating CE_n and CLK while preserving Vcc/VccQ.

compatibility_notes: All ONFI-compliant devices shall power-up into SDR data interface, timing mode 0 (slowest). Host shall issue Reset (FFh) before any commands.
Switching from SDR to NV-DDR / NV-DDR2 / NV-DDR3 is via Set Features (01h Timing Mode). Reset (FFh) drops back to SDR; Synchronous Reset (FCh) preserves the active interface.
Devices supporting only SDR (older silicon, ONFI 1.x baseline) do not advertise NV-DDR timing modes in the Parameter Page.
ECC scheme on raw NAND is host responsibility (BCH or LDPC); EZ NAND offloads ECC to the in-package controller.
Multi-vendor mixing on a single channel is allowed but discouraged due to ICC / VccQ / drive-strength matching considerations.

ONFI 4.x is backward compatible at the SDR command level with all previous ONFI revisions; advanced features (NV-DDR3, training commands 18h/62h/63h/64h/76h) are version-gated via the Parameter Page Revision Number (byte 4-5).
